**PotentialWax 1.5.0**

- **SAVE KIT**: one tap saves the 16 pads as a real **MPC drum program**: each pad as a WAV, as you hear it (at your tempo, key and pitch), on pads A01-A16, with a MIDI file beside it that plays the 16 pads in order on the beat. Load it like any program, and keep it after the plugin is gone. It goes to `PotentialWax/Kits` on the song's drive, or to the folder named on the first line of `PotentialWax/kit-folder.txt` there, or of PotentialBreaks' `kit-folder.txt`, so both plugins can save to the same programs folder. Needs MPC OS 3.10.1 or later (the program format it writes).
- A pad set to **HOLD** is saved as **TO NEXT CUE** (a sample can't know how long you'd hold it). Each saved pad is at most 16 seconds.
- **RESCAN** moved to the BROWSE page, under LIBRARY, to make room for SAVE KIT next to SAVE PADS. One parameter was added at the end of the list (Save Kit); saved projects open as before.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialWax-1.5.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialWax-1.5.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialWax-1.5.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialWax-1.5.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/issues/new/choose).
